messages:
zoe: Noticed a bunch of onboarding logs where users paste full stack traces from the quickstart into #support. It's the raw Error objects from the JS SDK.

patrick: Oof. Do we know if that's the SDK throwing raw fetch errors, or the sample app surface?

zoe: SDK exposes FetchError (network) and ApiError (http). But in examples we do `console.error(e)` which prints internals. New users copy/paste and get confused.

lee: We should teach developers a pattern: surface a short user-facing string in the UI, and log a structured error to console/telemetry. Also make SDK exceptions carry stable fields so apps can map them.

sam: Agreed. Proposal: adopt a tiny public error contract across SDKs. Minimal fields: `name` (exception class), `code` (machine id), `status` (http status or 0 for network), `retryable` (bool), `hint` (short user text). Also attach `metadata` for provider-only details.

zoe: Example JS usage we can show in quickstart:

```js
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (err) {
  // user-facing
  showBanner(err.hint || "Something went wrong. Try again.");

  // developer log (hidden behind DEBUG flag)
  if (process.env.DEBUG) console.debug("Full error:", err);

  // telemetry
  trackEvent("sdk_error", { error_code: err.code, http_status: err.status });
}
```

patrick: Nice and concise. For Python quickstart we should show attribute access rather than printing traceback: `e.code`, `e.status`, `e.hint`.

lee: For mapping guidance: 401 -> AuthenticationError (retryable=false, hint= "Login / API key issue"), 403 -> AuthorizationError (similar), 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable=true with `retry_after` if provided), 5xx -> ServerError (retryable=true but exponential backoff), network socket/timeouts -> TransientNetworkError (retryable=true).

sam: Also recommend that sample apps never print full stack to end users. Use expandable dev panel if you want to show debug trace. This reduces support noise.

zoe: CI action idea: add a lint in sample-apps to flag any `console.error(e)` or `print(e)` in UI routes. `ci-bot` could fail the PR with a link to the error-handling doc.

ci-bot: Proposed check added to samples-ci in branch "error-contract-lint" — will run on PRs. :gear:

patrick: Docs: include a table mapping HTTP codes -> SDK exception names -> developer handling -> recommended user message. Add examples for common flows (refresh token flow for 401, backoff loop for 429, fallback to smaller model for 502).

docs-bot: Draft doc stub created: /docs/errors/contract.md — reviewers: @lee @zoe.

sam: One more thing: add telemetry keys to errors so growth can measure friction. Fields: `error_family` (auth/rate/server/network), `severity` (user_visible / background), `onboarding_step` if coming from quickstart. That will let us A/B test improved messages.

lee: Good call. We'll add that to the contract as optional fields. Also include guidance for third-party libs: "If you wrap SDK exceptions, preserve `code` and `status` on the wrapper." 

zoe: Action items: 1) patch js + py quickstarts to consume `err.hint` and show collapsible debug; 2) add lint to samples CI to catch raw prints; 3) docs contract + mapping table; 4) telemetry fields; 5) add changelog note for SDK parity.

patrick: I'll take the JS sample change and CI lint.

lee: I'll do Python quickstart + doc mapping table.

sam: I'll add telemetry schema and coordinate with growth for measurement.

zoe: Thanks team. Can we aim to land sample patches + CI check within 48h? :hourglass:

patrick: Yep. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/samples/pull/278 (WIP)

zoe: Dropping a mini spec in this thread for reference:

```
Public error contract (fields):
- name: string (e.g., "RateLimitError")
- code: string (stable machine id, e.g., "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
- status: integer (http code, 0 for network)
- retryable: boolean
- hint: short user-facing message
- retry_after: integer seconds (optional)
- telemetry: map string->string (optional) - fields: error_family, severity, onboarding_step
```

lee: Perfect. We'll avoid nested JSON in quickstarts; show accessors instead.

zoe: Great work. Once merged we'll update support docs and close this thread. :white_check_mark:
